_comment: CV content, from CV_Erick_Gatica_in_English.pdf. Entries render in the order given. 'kind' sets the timeline dot colour: research | teaching | industry | education | leadership.
summary: Ph.D. researcher at the University of Colorado Boulder specializing in optical diagnostics, laser absorption spectroscopy sensors for hydrogen and natural gas combustion, thermal-fluid modelling, and dual-comb spectroscopy. Experienced in university teaching, process simulation, solar desalination systems, and engineering consulting.

education.title: Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering
bullets: Fourth-year Ph.D. student and Fulbright Scholar.
M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering conferred May 2025.

education.title: Fulbright Pre-Academic Program
bullets: Six-week intensive multicultural academic leadership and research training program.

education.title: M.Sc. in Engineering Sciences, Chemical Engineering
bullets: GPA 6.8 / 7.0, graduated with Maximum Distinction.

education.title: Chemical Civil Engineer (B.S. + M.Eng. equivalent)
bullets: Class rank 1st (final mark 6.5 / 7.0), graduated with Distinction.

experience.title: Graduate Research Assistant
bullets: Develop software and hardware for laser-based sensors applied to hydrogen engines and combustion systems in the Precision Laser Diagnostics for Energy and the Environment Lab under Dr. Greg Rieker.
Implement real-time data acquisition, optical diagnostics and embedded system workflows.

experience.title: Research Assistant
bullets: Desalination processes using phase change materials and solar energy, focusing on building and modelling the processes.

experience.title: Adjunct Lecturer / Instructor
bullets: Taught undergraduate courses in Process Control.

experience.title: University Instructor & Teaching Assistant
bullets: Laboratory and recitation classes in Transport Phenomena, Mass Transfer, Chemical Process Calculations and Process Engineering Thermodynamics for Chemical Civil Engineering.
Mathematics, applied thermodynamics and algebra recitations across the Faculty of Engineering and the Faculty of Administration and Economics.

experience.title: Technical Editor
bullets: Reviewed and edited theoretical foundations and applied exercises for the Handbook of Chemical Reactor Design by Dr. Aldo Saavedra.

experience.title: Independent Consulting Engineer
bullets: Consulting engineering for client projects in environmental sustainability, energy efficiency and renewable energy.

experience.title: FONDECYT Support Staff
bullets: Managed experiments and supervised thesis work in a FONDECYT project on solar energy storage, spouted beds and water desalination.

experience.title: Chemical Civil Engineering Intern
bullets: Worked with the plant and laboratory teams on experimental designs for process optimization.
Analysed reducing sugars and correlated them with the degree of caramelization in special caramel-type malts.

experience.title: Fluid Mechanics Laboratory Assistant
bullets: Conducted fluid mechanics experiments using prototype-scale equipment.

experience.title: Differential Equations Teaching Assistant
bullets: Face-to-face recitation classes supporting engineering coursework in differential equations.

experience.title: Chemical Laboratory Technician Intern
bullets: Fertilizer analysis (blue and yellow phosphorus, sulfur, biuret) and nutritional analysis of food samples.
Prepared validated technical reports for national and international clients.

Organized orientation activities for international students and produced marketing content.
